trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Complete the 54 other trophies first. This is the reward at the end of the checklist, not a separate activity to search for.

steps.text: Use the saved checklist to identify any remaining category.
Check the console trophy page too
the in-app counter follows your local ticks.
After the final outstanding trophy unlocks, allow the platinum notification to register.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the named opening mission. Follow Jason’s first marked story objective; no optional condition is attached to this bronze.

steps.text: Start the story and complete the prologue.
Continue into Gone Fishing when the mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives through its ending to register the story trophy.
Use the chapter-by-chapter list if an optional marker distracts from the opening story mission.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through the close of Chapter 1 and advance into Chapter 2. Optional jobs are separate from the chapter trophy.

steps.text: Keep following the main story missions in Chapter 1.
Finish its last story mission, Discharge Time.
Advance into the opening of Chapter 2 to trigger the chapter-complete award.
The award triggers at the next chapter’s opening, so check the trophy screen after advancing.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Reach the end of Chapter 2 and let the story cross into Chapter 3. Nothing in the list identifies a branch choice for this trophy.

steps.text: Continue the main missions in Paradise Lost.
Finish the chapter and advance to Welcome to Vice City.
Verify the bronze appears as Chapter 3 begins.
The trophy guide places the award as Chapter 3 begins after Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 and begin Chapter 4. The story mission list gives the order; avoid confusing the label with a side activity.

steps.text: Follow the numbered main story missions through Chapter 3.
Finish the chapter’s closing mission.
Play the next chapter’s opening beats and confirm the trophy notification.
The source treats this as a chapter transition, not a collectible or medal challenge.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Advance through Chapter 4’s close into the last chapter. Save an ordinary manual save as a general safeguard before major story transitions.

steps.text: Follow Chapter 4’s story line to its ending.
Finish the closing chapter mission and continue.
Confirm the chapter trophy before starting optional cleanup.
Keep this Chapter 4 milestone separate from the gold for the actual final story mission.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission, The End of the Road. Free roam remains available afterwards, so this is not a whole-game point of no return.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 5 main-story sequence.
Start and complete The End of the Road.
Return to free roam, then finish any remaining side activities and collections.
The cited roadmap says free roam continues after the credits for cleanup.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. Resume the main mission marker if you have been doing side jobs.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 2 story sequence in Port Gellhorn.
Select Breakfast Run when it becomes the active mission.
Complete its objectives to earn the bronze.
The mission reference places Breakfast Run in Chapter 2’s motel sequence.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Its name is a story-mission prerequisite, not a request to rob every bank.

steps.text: Continue the Chapter 3 story until The Cartel Heist is offered.
Complete the heist mission objectives.
Check the trophy list once its ending sequence has played.
Continue through the heist mission chain, since an unrelated free-roam bank job is not the trigger.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child’s Play in Chapter 4. The trophy’s official condition is the mission completion, without a stated medal or optional objective.

steps.text: Progress through Chapter 4’s main story.
Start Child’s Play when it appears.
Finish the mission and let its completion register.
The listed mission has no gold-medal objective, completing it is the stated condition.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners during Chapter 4. Do not skip the main mission marker in favor of the optional jobs around it.

steps.text: Advance the Chapter 4 story to Headliners.
Complete the mission objectives with Jason and Lucia.
Confirm the bronze before continuing the main sequence.
Follow the main mission marker rather than a similarly themed optional Dimez appearance.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4. The mission name is the full listed condition.

steps.text: Follow Chapter 4’s main mission sequence to the airport job.
Finish VCIA Takedown.
Check the console tracker after the mission wrap-up.
The airport story heist and the separate airport free-roam theft are distinct trophy routes.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It arrives in the final story chapter; no optional completion counter is specified.

steps.text: Start Chapter 5 after Chapter 4 closes.
Continue to Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission and verify the bronze unlock.
This main-story mission comes after the Chapter 4 airport sequence.

trophies.availability: Automatic story milestone; no optional branch is specified.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach the game’s weighted 100% checklist. The trophy targets below often exceed individual trophy thresholds; the in-game checklist is the final authority when early guides conflict.

steps.text: Complete the story. Progress → Stats → 100% Completion then appears, with earlier activity already credited.
Clear the full robbery requirements: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans and all 8 vaults. Take every key valuable at operations.
Finish all 42 range golds, 42 drone time trials, 33 underwater discoveries and 15 Bret Target Decks. These full sets cannot be replaced by other activities.
Meet the partial targets too: 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 15 card sets, 15 meditations, 100 WAiNK locations and 200 vehicle models. Use the full completion table below.
Use the in-game counter for disputed Optional Tasks, Stick Ups and Marked Bills targets. Finish the eight-strand Stranger trophy separately; 100% alone does not guarantee the platinum.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: The trophy asks for 250 stunts. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep tracking after this silver unlocks.

steps.text: Use the map’s Stunt Spots and the Progress activity counter.
Mix stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.
Continue until the trophy counter reaches 250
keep going to 300 for A Long Road.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the nine tracked activity types. The variety requirement is broader than finishing a single hobby.

steps.text: Visit Progress → Activities and note the types you have tried.
Sample fishing, hunting, golf, shooting, pool, basketball, arcade play, a race and a stunt.
Recheck the activity panel for a missing type before leaving the area.
A race win can fill the racing sample, but it does not replace the other eight activity types.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn 42 gold medals across 12 Shooting Ranges. This complete activity set also satisfies its 100% category.

steps.text: Find a Shooting Range through the activity map and start a challenge. Check the displayed gold score before firing.
Work through every challenge at the current range, improving accuracy and speed until each medal is gold.
Move between ranges until you have all 42 golds across the 12 locations. Check the range counter for gaps.
Range practice also improves Focus, making Gunslinger easier. These same 42 golds are required for A Long Road.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. One win per venue earns this trophy; all 42 trials are needed for 100%.

steps.text: Use the activity map to locate a Top Fun Drone Race venue. Win its event before moving on.
Repeat at each of the 14 distinct locations. Repeating one venue does not replace a missing location.
If planning the platinum, complete all three trials at each location now: the 100% list requires 42 completions.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeating one course does not fill a different-race slot. There are enough distinct options to choose a comfortable mix.

steps.text: Open the race markers and select an event you have not won.
Finish first, then select a different race rather than replaying the same one.
Repeat until the tracked different-race wins reach 20.
Choose a new course each time, a repeat win does not count as a distinct race.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the early Cal story introduction, follow his fishing-quest messages and win his challenge. This specific win is different from simply trying fishing once.

steps.text: Complete the Feng Shui mission to meet Cal’s fishing thread.
Respond to his follow-up and travel to its marked fishing spot.
Win Cal’s challenge and check the trophy notification.
Cal’s challenge is a follow-up quest, not simply any session spent fishing.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Use the home TV games or an arcade cabinet and reach the game’s end state.

steps.text: Start any available arcade game from the TV or a cabinet.
Play through its complete round rather than only opening the machine.
Confirm the game registers as completed before switching activities.
The guide lists three home TV games and a cabinet game as available starting points.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy’s five-mission Cellerica strand as Lucia. His Chapter 3 message provides the starting address in Belville.

steps.text: Switch to Lucia after Chapter 3 begins and follow Andy’s text to Belville.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee and Peach! as the follow-ups appear.
Finish Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass for the trophy. This strand remains available after the story.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s seven-wreck treasure chain. His temporary absence after Chapter 1 is a delay, not a proven trophy lockout.

steps.text: Meet Kenton at the green KR icon in Key Lento after his Chapter 1 introduction.
Visit the purple chest markers, dive at the shipwrecks and use the metal detector to recover the treasure.
Track Progress → Collections → Kenton’s Treasures. Work through all seven wreck assignments.
If he disappears after Chapter 1, continue the story and watch for his later text to Jason. Finish the final assignment when he returns.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy’s final dirt-bike strand mission. The series follows the early Thrillbilly introduction but remains side content.

steps.text: Meet Billy at the Thrillbilly Mud Club after his Chapter 2 strand opens.
Accept follow-up jobs as they appear and work through the series.
Finish Hometown Heroes and check the trophy list.
The strand guide identifies Hometown Heroes as Billy’s fifth job.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands. The full qualifying roster is still unresolved; not every character with a personal trophy advances this counter.

steps.text: Start with the confirmed qualifying strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Complete each chain through its final mission.
Check the PS5 trophy’s counter before and after a finale. Do not assume Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Yasmani or Eddie advances it.
Allow time for follow-up texts and later-chapter contacts; strand missions can take several in-game days to appear.
Continue qualifying strands until the counter reaches eight. The remaining roster is not fully confirmed in the consulted guides.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy’s 16 requested sports-car deliveries after the Key Cloner introduction.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, finish Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS to unlock Randy’s Wish List. Locate his RK garage in west Vice City.
Check the request list and scan candidate cars with WAiNK. Look around hotel driveways in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Deliver each requested model in good condition for a better payout. Complete all 16 and the final job.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s lab-destruction strand. His final job follows his earlier Chapter 3 introduction; continue after each contact rather than repeating one site.

steps.text: Complete Here, Kitty Kitty to start Tyrone’s sequence.
Clear the purple-marked synthetic lab jobs as Jason.
Complete Tyrone’s final mission and confirm the trophy.
The Chapter 3 introduction must happen before Tyrone’s finale is available.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 1 balcony session as a precaution, then work toward 18 recorded meditations. Sources do not agree whether the balcony is compulsory. The separate 100% target is only 15 meditations.

steps.text: Chapter 1: finish Down to Earth. The next morning, return to Jason’s house and speak to Lucia in the kitchen.
Follow her to the balcony, speak again and choose Accept. Do this before leaving Chapter 1; the invitation disappears later.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save. This session increments the counter, but sources have not confirmed whether the trophy requires it.
Continue to Coffee Break in Chapter 2 so both characters can travel together. Visit marked meditation spots with Jason and Lucia.
Meditate as both characters where available; each character’s session counts. Continue toward 18 in Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations.
Check the trophy’s all-spots counter, not just the 100% screen: A Long Road asks for 15 of 18. Preserve the balcony save until this trophy unlocks.

trophies.availability: Chapter 1 balcony window: preserve a save; trophy dependency remains unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take a qualifying animal for Bret’s hunting strand and complete the associated hunting job. This trophy is not the same as studying wildlife with binoculars.

steps.text: Start Bret’s Chapter 2 hunting strand after Coffee Break.
Follow a Target Deck and hunt the requested unique animal as Jason.
Complete the return or turn-in objective and verify the trophy.
Bret’s contract hunt is separate from photographing or studying ordinary wildlife.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three entire card sets. Select sets with the fewest missing cards in the Collections menu; individual cards do not count as sets.

steps.text: Open Progress → Collections and pick three sets to finish. IGN’s card reference lists the set names and sizes.
Look through garages and residences while exploring. Use the cited card-page links to locate the missing cards in your selected sets.
Check that all three sets show complete. A Long Road later requires 15 of the 18 sets, so keep the collection checklist.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 distinct WAiNK points of interest. Vehicle discoveries use the same app but a different counter.

steps.text: Watch for a nearby WAiNK notification. Press D-pad Up and hold R1 to scan a point of interest.
Collect the 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures; supplement these with Peewees billboards and No Flusher road tags.
Examples include the IAA Friend of Freedom monument downtown, the Derelict Spy Vessel in Permit Keys and the Mermaid Display at Vice City Oceanarium.
Track 100 locations out of the 108 listed by IGN. This also clears the WAiNK category for 100% completion.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The 100% target is higher, so use the challenge menu to keep the silver-to-100% cleanup visible.

steps.text: Open Progress → Challenges and review the available set.
Finish repeatable world, race and activity challenges as they naturally unlock.
Confirm 50 completed
target 70 if finishing the full 100% checklist.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner, lose a four-star pursuit, then clear the residual Heat. Bank vaults offer a natural way to combine this with other trophies.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner using the character menu so both are travelling together.
Reach four stars. A bank-vault job later in the game creates a four-star pursuit, allowing a combined attempt.
Break police sight; the tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the trophy guide’s suggested escape route.
Leave the red heat area with your partner. Clear the remaining recognition indicators and wait for the award; merely losing visual contact is not enough.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in one continuous Wanted streak with your partner. Prepare a short route before starting the first robbery.

steps.text: Bring a partner, armour and healing supplies. The three north Vice City jewelry stores provide a compact route after Yasmani’s Chapter 3 introduction.
Rob the first shop, then reach the second and third while the Wanted state stays active. Do not finish an escape between shops.
After the third, allow time for the notification. The cited guide reports a delay of about 30 seconds; if it fails, try a fourth shop within the same streak.
Only clear your Wanted level once the award has registered. Use the Heat guide for a getaway afterwards.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 distinct vehicles through WAiNK. Scanning is enough; stealing or purchasing each vehicle is not part of the description.

steps.text: Open WAiNK on the phone while near passing traffic.
Scan new vehicle models rather than repeating familiar ones.
Check Progress and continue toward 100
the 100% checklist uses a higher vehicle-scan target.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus. Prepare a full meter and a group of hostile targets first.

steps.text: Refill your Focus before fighting. Carry a weapon suited to several rapid takedowns, such as an assault rifle.
Find a gang operation with five enemies in reach. The trophy guide says civilians, police and soldiers may not count; use gang hostiles.
Aim, then click L3 and R3 together. Combat Focus drains while aiming; take down all five before this one activation ends.
If the meter runs out, refill and try a fresh group. Shooting Ranges improve Focus and also advance The Shootist.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Take a passenger jet from an airport boarding bridge and escape. A plane parked elsewhere on the apron is not the setup described in the sourced tip.

steps.text: Travel to the VCIA terminal and identify a jet attached to a boarding bridge.
Get aboard, take off from the airport and gain distance from the airfield.
Lose the resulting pursuit and confirm the trophy.
The sourced airport tip names gates E3 and E4 as examples for bridge-parked jets.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino from Mile Zero Air Station on Mariana and use it against the base defenders. Leave room for a Wanted-level escape afterwards.

steps.text: Travel to the restricted Mile Zero base on the southwest island of Mariana.
Reach the Rhino tanks near the southern part of the facility and take one.
Use the tank against hostile targets, then finish the resulting encounter.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Use a quiet back-door entry to rob a jewelry store undetected. The Chapter 3 Snap Gun unlock is the key preparation.

steps.text: Complete Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs introduction in Chapter 3 to obtain the Snap Gun.
Approach a jewelry store’s locked rear door; use the Snap Gun rather than kicking the door and triggering the alarm.
Locate the safe-code note in the back room, empty the safe and leave unseen. The guide suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five separate bank vaults and escape after each. Start the Chapter 4 vault introduction before searching for accessible vaults.

steps.text: Complete That’s Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4. Its café meeting introduces the vault robbery system.
Tail a security van to its bank. When the guard opens the vault for a cash delivery, enter and take the haul.
Bring your partner to carry a second bag. Escape the four-star response on a fast bike, then change vehicles and leave the Heat zone.
Repeat at five different vaults. Complete all eight for A Long Road; Yasmani can sell van tips for $10,000 after his earlier jobs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Open an armored truck’s rear cargo, collect the money and escape the Heat zone.

steps.text: Find an armored truck and block its movement using another vehicle. Prepare sticky bombs before the attempt.
Place a sticky bomb on the rear doors, move clear and detonate it. Collect the cash from the truck.
Break pursuit and clear the red Heat area. The consulted guide also reports bank-vault robberies can trigger this trophy, but the truck route matches the official condition directly.

citations.name: IGN
citations.title: Wanted Guide: Escape the Cops and Clear Heat

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal the full Leonida map. Use fast travel by road, boat or plane to uncover the remaining fogged regions.

steps.text: Open the world map and identify unexplored dark patches.
Travel through the counties and along the edges of the map to expose them.
Recheck the map for residual fog until the exploration trophy unlocks.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Complete the map objectives and check gang coverage.

steps.text: Find the yellow illegal-operation icons around Leonida. Select one belonging to a gang you have not robbed yet.
Take the operation’s key valuables; hover over the map icon to see how many are still missing.
Use Progress → Gangs to confirm coverage of all nine gangs. For 100% completion, go on to clear all 39 operations.

trophies.availability: No trophy missable condition identified by the consulted guides; available in later free roam.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The precise Ocean Beach cocktail venue is not confirmed in the consulted guide. The official description is a clue, not evidence of a particular rooftop.

steps.text: Official clue: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No specific bar is established by the consulted guide.
Keep this on your unresolved list during Ocean Beach exploration. Do not commit a long detour to an uncited venue claim.
Revisit the linked trophy guide for a confirmed trigger. Mark earned only after the console awards it.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A showroom exit is implied, but the exact vehicle and showroom are unconfirmed. Avoid treating a visual joke as a verified walkthrough.

Keep a save before experimenting; no confirmed method is available in the consulted guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Clear Kolt & Associates’ Kingpin Bowling operation in Port Gellhorn. Loot its three key valuables, then escape.

steps.text: After Hit Kingpin Bowling appears in Chapter 2, enter the Port Gellhorn bowling alley. Bring sticky bombs for the safe.
Take the luxury watch from the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 from the northeast table, and the northeast-hallway safe contents.
Lose the police to trigger the award. The guide says items can be collected over multiple visits, but the operation takes a long time to respawn.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise Strength to its maximum for both Jason and Lucia. Train together where possible, then check each character rather than assuming one workout completes both.

steps.text: Visit an available gym or fitness-club activity.
Work out with your partner present so both characters can make progress.
Check each character’s Strength stat until both are maxed.

steps.text: Enable Criminal Profile notifications in Settings → UI to watch qualifying actions while playing.
Accumulate 500 profile-affecting actions through normal play. The description does not ask you to reach Irredeemable.
Keep an earlier save if your profile nears Irredeemable: IGN says that state cannot be reversed except by loading a save.

roadmap.title: Protect the one risky window
roadmap.note: Possible missable · do Lucia’s balcony meditation when it appears; trophy dependency is unconfirmed.

steps.text: Keep a Chapter 1 manual save. The balcony meditation may disappear when the chapter closes, though the guide has not confirmed whether it is required for the meditation trophy.
Complete Gone Fishing and each story transition at your own pace; the story trophies are milestone unlocks, not collectible branches.
Side missions Get Shirley’s Rum and Steal the Scooter are chapter-limited. The mission guide says these do not block trophies or 100% completion.

roadmap.title: Build your activity counters
roadmap.note: Start repeatable hobbies early; counters survive story progress.

steps.text: Try one each of fishing, hunting, golf, range shooting, pool, basketball, arcade, racing and stunts for Master of None.
Start Bret’s hunting deck, Cal’s fishing challenges and Billy’s strand when they open. Track their own final missions for Fair Game, Baited My Tackle and The Lone Rider.
Scan new vehicles and WAiNK points while roaming. The platinum-adjacent counters are only 200 vehicle models and 100 WAiNK scans for the 100% checklist.

roadmap.title: Work the Vice City strands
roadmap.note: Optional character trophies · finish strand-specific jobs after they begin.

steps.text: Complete the story to the Key Cloner and start Andy, Randy, Yasmani and Tyrone’s available strands; use their own mission counters to track follow-ups.
Use the trophy’s progress counter for Strangers & Freaks: GTABase warns that not every stranger strand qualifies, so count only confirmed progress.
If a Yago race or optional phone pickup appears time-limited, finish it for side-content completion. The guide says these optional windows do not gate any listed trophy.

roadmap.title: Open the vault route & finish the story
roadmap.note: Do the Chapter 4 vault introduction before relying on the bank counter; free roam continues after credits.

steps.text: Complete That’s Where the Money Is… when it opens. It introduces the security-van bank-vault loop used by Maximum Withdrawal.
Keep the optional job This Is a Free Call From… on your general missable-mission audit. It has no trophy consequence per the current mission guide.
Complete VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory and The End of the Road for the remaining listed story trophies.

roadmap.title: Finish the tracker, then take the platinum
roadmap.note: The actual in-game completion checklist is authoritative when sources disagree.

steps.text: Clear every category in Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Prior work counts; the 100% screen appears after the story.
Full-set categories include bank-vault jobs, gang operations, range golds, drone time trials and Bret’s Target Decks. Many other counters require only their listed subset.
Complete eight qualifying Stranger strands separately: the trophy roadmap source conflicts with the completion guide about whether those quests count as optional tasks.
Verify the game’s 100% state and all 54 other PS5 trophies; Vice Got a Price! then completes the set.

entries.name: Positive Mental Attitude
entries.action: Accept the balcony meditation when prompted; save before Chapter 1 closes.
entries.confidence: The location is time-limited; whether it is required by the trophy remains unconfirmed.

missableAudit.clarification: Other chapter-limited optional missions can be missed, but the cited completion guide says they do not block a trophy or 100% completion.

disputes.title: Balcony meditation: precaution, not a proven requirement
disputes.text: The trophy guide says Lucia’s Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears and labels the trophy possibly missable; it also says the spot’s requirement has not been confirmed. Do the meditation before leaving Chapter 1 and keep a save. The audit does not claim a proven platinum lockout.

disputes.title: Do Strangers & Freaks strands count toward 100%?
disputes.text: GTABase’s trophy guide says the eight strands are not part of 100%; its 100% checklist says Stranger quests contribute to Optional Tasks. Treat the in-game 100% tracker as decisive; finish eight separately for the trophy.

disputes.title: Time-limited side missions are not trophy missables
disputes.text: The story guide marks selected optional missions as chapter-limited, while the 100% guide says none are needed for 100%. Preserve a manual save if you want every side job, but do not label those windows as trophy requirements.

disputes.title: Cryptic descriptions remain explicitly unresolved
disputes.text: The consulted trophy guide has no verified trigger for In The Beginning… and notes uncertainty around several joke-description trophies. The steps label those routes as leads, not facts; recheck the linked source instead of trusting folklore.

disputes.title: Early 100% guides disagree on counters
disputes.text: IGN’s table gives 100 Stick Ups and $100,000 Marked Bills, while GTABase lists 50 distinct Stick Ups and $250,000 Marked Bills. IGN’s prose also says all optional missions; GTABase lists 100 Optional Tasks. Follow the game’s Progress screen. Dime on the Dollar itself explicitly requires $250,000.

disputes.title: Eighteen meditations for trophy; fifteen for 100%
disputes.text: The official description says every spot. GTABase and KeenGamer report 18 meditation sessions for the trophy, while the 100% list needs 15. The balcony is time-limited but its necessity remains unconfirmed. Safest route: do it in Chapter 1 and retain a save.
